scope: Phase 4A diagnostics only; production code, parameters, timing models and previous reports preserved

audit.coordinate_units: display pixels mapped to inference pixels; evaluation ray geometry uses published 54 x 35 degree field
audit.calibration_note: Published supplement: 22-inch, 1680x1050 display, 47 cm viewing distance, 54 x 35 degree field. Evaluation uses normalized flat-display rays from those rounded angles, not participant-specific calibration. COCO-Periph 16 pixels/degree and the observer pseudo-camera are not human calibration.
limitations: Padding rule matches the mirror helper; official 1680x1050 stimulus files not locally available for pixelwise verification.
No per-fixation onset or saccade durations in the local JSON. Cumulative T clipping at RT is an approximation, not verified wall-clock alignment.
Image+participant alone is not a unique trial key across search categories; this phase uses image+participant+task.

aggregation: Average seeds/steps within image+participant+task; tasks within image+participant; participants within image; scenes equally. Image bootstrap 2000. Seeds are not scenes.
oracle: Future coordinate added to a copy of the frozen candidate set with nearest existing candidate utility. This changes coverage only and has no access to future semantics. Metrics only; never normal inference.
limits: Exploratory, previously examined internal split of a small local mirror subset; not official benchmark test.
Reported 54x35 degree display geometry gives approximate ray angles, not individual calibration.
No raw event timestamps: response-time matching is approximate; lower-window and fixed-prefix sensitivities included.
SSDLite reference boxes are noisy evaluation proxies. Outside them is unclassified, not verified empty. All-object segmentation ground truth remains unavailable.
No model fitted or selected on this diagnostic test.
